labels.name: component/mixin
labels.rationale: The issue reports a bug in the alerting rules generated by the Prometheus mixin.

items.body: Thanks for the detailed report and suggested fix. This appears to be a clear, actionable bug in the alerting rules generated by the Prometheus mixin, where a label mismatch prevents the alert from firing as intended. The maintainers will review your findings and proposed change. If you would like to open a pull request with your fix, it would be welcome.
